class.name: MaszynaHeightmapTerrainProvider
class.brief_description: Supplies the original's heightmap terrain region by region from its pack files.
class.description: A streaming provider of a heightmap terrain a scenery names ([code]heightmap_terrain[/code]): its pack files (.tch, [MaszynaHeightmapTerrainPack]) listed as it opens, and the regions of 1 km - the streaming's cells - supplied as the camera comes near as [MaszynaHeightmapTerrainRegion]s ([constant SceneryStreamingProvider.CONTENT_HEIGHTMAP]), their chunks read on the streaming worker. [MaszynaHeightmapTerrainRenderingServer] takes them by the terrain they name.

method.name: get_chunk_count
method.description: The chunks its pack files hold.

method.name: get_terrain
method.description: The terrain its regions name, set with [method set_terrain].

method.name: open
method.description: Opens the pack files of [param directory] - [code]terrain/<name>/[/code] of the game. Returns [code]false[/code], with an error, when it holds none.

method.name: set_range
method.description: How far from the camera its regions are wanted [lb]m[rb] ([method SceneryStreamingProvider.get_range]) - as far as its terrain draws them, [method MaszynaHeightmapTerrainRenderingServer.terrain_get_range], past the draw distance. Given before the provider is registered.

method.name: set_terrain
method.description: The terrain its regions are drawn in ([method MaszynaHeightmapTerrainRenderingServer.terrain_create]), given before the provider is registered.
